dataSource: Synthesized reference grid calibrated to the New World Atlas of Artificial Night Sky Brightness (Falchi et al., 2016) and International Dark-Sky Association (IDA) Dark Sky Reserves.
limits: Offline reference grid provides regional baseline Bortle estimates and designated dark sky sites within 10-150 km. It cannot dynamically capture temporary local ground lights (e.g., stadium floodlights, streetlamps 20 meters away). Field validation with red-light vision adaptation is recommended.
